function(recursive_glob folder sources_var)
    file(GLOB_RECURSE files RELATIVE ${folder} *.c *.S)
    list(APPEND ${sources_var} ${files})
    set(${sources_var} ${${sources_var}} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

target_link_options(GPIO_Demo PRIVATE
    -mcmodel=medium
    -fmessage-length=0
    -ffunction-sections
    -fdata-sections
    -flto
    -Werror
    -O2
    -g3
    -Wall
    -Wextra
    -Wshadow
    -Wimplicit-fallthrough
    -Wpointer-arith
    -Wredundant-decls
    -Wcast-qual
    -Wsign-compare
    -Wunused-parameter
    -Wunused-variable
    -Wswitch
    -Wstrict-prototypes
    -Wmissing-field-initializers
    -Wdeprecated-declarations
    -Wenum-conversion
    -Wpacked-not-aligned
    -Waddress-of-packed-member
    -Wundef
    -Xlinker --gc-sections
    -nostartfiles
    -T${ProjDirPath}/chip/tl322x/link/D25F/flash_boot.link   # ✅ still D25F linker
    -mcpu=d25f                                             
    -fomit-frame-pointer
    -fno-strict-aliasing
    -std=c99
    -fno-jump-tables
    -fno-fat-lto-objects
    -fuse-ld=bfd
    "-Wl,-Map,GPIO_Demo.map,--defsym,__D25F_DRAM_SIZE=0x20000,--defsym,__D25F_IRAM_SIZE=0x4000"
)
